candidate.answerReason: The incenter bisects the angles at A and B, giving angles 25° and 30° in triangle AIB. Its third angle is 180° − 25° − 30° = 125°.

methods.label: Use the angle bisectors
methods.explanation: \(AI\) and \(BI\) bisect \(\angle A\) and \(\angle B\), respectively. Thus \(\angle IAB+\angle IBA=25^\circ+30^\circ=55^\circ\), so \(\angle AIB=180^\circ-55^\circ=125^\circ\).
